title: Berberine-taxifolin co-administration attenuates inflammatory response and intestinal barrier injury via nf-kappaB/NLRP3 suppression in colitis.
authors: Miao, Ganggang; Zhang, De; Sui, Zhenghui; Leng, Jianfei; Deng, Yanxiang; Gu, Xingwei; Cao, Hongyong
one_liner_zh: 该文研究小檗碱与花旗松素联用对结肠炎的抗炎和肠屏障保护作用，分子对接仅涉及小分子-蛋白靶点，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) is pathologically characterized by dysregulated inflammation and compromised intestinal barrier integrity. While multi-component herbal formulations hold promise for IBD management, the combined potential of specific phytochemical combinations remains underexplored. This study investigates the cooperative therapeutic effects of Berberine and Taxifolin, two anti-inflammatory phytochemicals, in a murine colitis model. Multi-omics network pharmacology initially identified their shared anti-inflammatory and anti-apoptotic targets in IBD pathogenesis. Experimental validation demonstrated that combined treatment with berberine and taxifolin produced stronger protective effects against Dextran Sulfate Sodium (DSS)-induced colitis than either compound alone. Specifically, the combination significantly alleviated body weight loss and colon shortening, reduced macrophage infiltration and the expression of pro-inflammatory cytokines (IL-1beta and TNF-alpha), and preserved intestinal barrier integrity by restoring tight junction proteins (occludin and ZO-1). In addition, the combined treatment attenuated caspase-3-mediated epithelial apoptosis. Molecular docking analysis suggested that berberine and taxifolin may interact with multiple inflammation-related targets, including NF-kappaB, NLRP3, PPARgamma, and STAT3, providing a potential mechanistic basis for the observed effects. These findings establish Berberine-Taxifolin co-administration as a novel multi-target therapeutic strategy that concurrently addresses inflammatory dysregulation, barrier repair, and apoptosis control in IBD, and may provide a phytochemical blueprint for complex inflammatory disorders.
abstract_zh: 炎症性肠病（IBD）的病理特征为炎症调控失调和肠道屏障完整性受损。尽管多组分草药配方在IBD治疗中具有潜力，但特定植物化学组合的联合潜力仍未充分探索。本研究探讨了小檗碱（Berberine）和花旗松素（Taxifolin）——两种抗炎植物化学物——在小鼠结肠炎模型中的协同治疗效应。多组学网络药理学初步识别了它们在IBD发病机制中的共同抗炎和抗凋亡靶点。实验验证表明，小檗碱和花旗松素联合治疗对葡聚糖硫酸钠（DSS）诱导的结肠炎产生了比任一单一化合物更强的保护作用。具体而言，该组合显著减轻了体重下降和结肠缩短，减少了巨噬细胞浸润及促炎细胞因子（IL-1β和TNF-α）的表达，并通过恢复紧密连接蛋白（occludin和ZO-1）维持了肠道屏障完整性。此外，联合治疗减弱了caspase-3介导的上皮细胞凋亡。分子对接分析提示，小檗碱和花旗松素可能与多个炎症相关靶点相互作用，包括NF-κB、NLRP3、PPARγ和STAT3，为观察到的效应提供了潜在的机制基础。这些发现确立了小檗碱-花旗松素联合给药作为一种新型多靶点治疗策略，可同时应对IBD中的炎症失调、屏障修复和凋亡控制，并可能为复杂炎症性疾病提供植物化学蓝图。
